Best ad intelligence tools for mobile gaming 2026
Tomas Hubka
Last updated: Aug 19, 2026
min read
Compare the best ad intelligence tools for mobile gaming in 2026. See pricing, features, and which platform fits your studio's creative research needs.
Mobile gaming is the most creative-intensive ad ecosystems in the world. User Acquisition (UA) teams are testing dozens of new creatives a week, watching what competitors run, and trying to spot the formats that are scaling before they're everywhere. Without the right tools, this work is slow, expensive, and full of blind spots.
This guide compares the six leading ad and creative intelligence platforms for mobile gaming in 2026. We've ranked them by depth of creative intelligence: the more a tool reveals about why competitor creatives are working, not just that they're running, the higher up the list it sits.
If you're evaluating an ad intelligence tool right now, the decision usually comes down to three questions:
How much creative depth do you need? Just impressions, or impressions plus engagement metrics, campaign goal, and audience demographics?
How fast do you need to see new ads? Hours, days, or weeks after launch?
How do you want to evaluate before deciding? Hands-on with a free trial, or through demos and sales conversations?
Use the table below to scan the options, or dive into more details below for a deeper understanding of which one fits.

Ad Insights from GameAnalytics
1. Ad Insights (by GameAnalytics)
Overview
Ad Insights is the ad intelligence platform available in GameAnalytics' MarketIQ Suite. While most competitors approach ad intelligence as part of a broader market intelligence suite, Ad Insights is built specifically for creative teams who need to know what's working in their competitors' ads and why.
Key strengths
Broad Coverage:
3 billion+ creatives across 160+ ad networks (including networks without public libraries) and 148 countries.
Creative Search:
Search inside three billion ad creatives by what's actually in them: gameplay mechanics, UI elements, hooks, and concepts, rather than filtering only by tags and metadata.
Performance signals beyond share of voice:
Impressions, engagement metrics, campaign goal classification, and monetization method all sit side by side, giving you the full picture rather than a single performance indicator.
Audience demographics:
Age, gender, interests, and geographic targeting data for ad audiences.
Retention curves (D1 to D360):
Full retention data alongside DAU/MAU and revenue, giving creative teams ROI context in one place.
Same-day data:
Ads launched the same day appear in the platform, so creative teams can lead trends rather than chase them.
Transparent, accessible pricing:
$299 per month billed annually or $499 per month, with 10 seats included. Same price for every studio.
Self-serve free trial:
14 days. No qualifying conversation, no sales call required.
When it's right for you
Ad Insights is built for game studios that prioritize creative intelligence over broad market intelligence. Best fit for UA teams running structured creative sprints, performance marketing teams testing ad concepts, and creative strategists looking for inspiration and validation across a large competitive set.
